name: Sméagol
subtitle: Hurried Guide
game_text:
<keyword>Ring-bound</keyword>. To play, add a burden.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: If you have initiative, discard 2 cards from your hand. Sméagol cannot be overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
flavor_text: “‘Wake up! Wake up! Wake up, sleepies! We must go, yes, we must go at once!’”
